'''Tarkin's Shears''' was a [[Water Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. An Outlaw-level variant of the [[Luzitall]], the Shears increased the difficulty by adding five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Pike/Legends|pikes]].<ref name="BSS" />
